channel.description: Latest articles from World of Reel (worldofreel.com)

item.title: Live-Action ‘Moana’ Trailer Arrives — and Somehow, It’s Worse Than Expected — World of Reel
item.description: Everything looks artificial, from the over-the-top CGI to the flat, lifeless backdrops—how does the animated version feel more real than this so-called live-action update?

item.title: Ruben Östlund Cast in ‘The Studio’ Season Two — World of Reel
item.description: I’m hearing two-time Palme d’Or winner Ruben Östlund (“Triangle of Sadness”) will appear in the second season of Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg’s Apple TV+ series “The Studio.”

item.title: Kirsten Dunst to Star in ‘The Housemaid’ Sequel — World of Reel
item.description: Kirsten Dunst continues to cash in those big paychecks. She will join Sydney Sweeney in “The Housemaid’s Secret,” the sequel set to begin filming this fall.

item.title: Zach Cregger’s ‘Flood’ Lands Theatrical Rollout at Netflix? — Deep-Space Crew Faces Time-Warping Alien Horror — World of Reel
item.description: Cregger and Netflix have reached a deal for “Flood” to potentially be his next film. The streamer will probably give this one the same type of rollout that Greta Gerwig’s ‘Narnia’ is set to garner this fall.

item.title: ‘Faces of Death’ Reboot Posters Banned From Theaters for “Too Intense” Imagery — World of Reel
item.description: This upcoming “Faces of Death” reboot is — wisely? — courting controversy before it’s even hit theaters. First it was the teaser, and now the posters are being banned.

item.title: Tom Ford’s ‘Cry To Heaven’ Wraps Production in Rome — Is A Venice 2026 Premiere Possible? — World of Reel
item.description: Ford’s comeback film has wrapped production in Rome. This gives him five months of post-production work if he wants to premiere the film at the Venice Film Festival in early September.

item.title: After ‘Dinner in America,’ Adam Rehmeier Returns With Samara Weaving in ‘Carolina Caroline' — Watch the Teaser — World of Reel
item.description: If you’re among those who have been championing Adam Rehmeier’s “Dinner in America” as passionately as I have, and then “Snack Shack,” then this one’s for you.

item.title: 50 Years Later — The Best Films of 1976 — World of Reel
item.description: Continuing on with this series, here’s a look back at 1976, which stands as one of the defining years of the New Hollywood era—a moment when American cinema reached a kind of creative peak.

item.title: Johnny Depp Shooting Mysterious Netflix Horror Movie in the UK? — World of Reel
item.description: What exactly is Johnny Depp shooting in the UK? According to locals, Depp has been quietly filming a Netflix horror movie due for October release.

item.title: Sony’s ‘Jumanji 3’ Moves to Christmas, Leaving December 11 Open — Could “Dunesday” Shift? — World of Reel
item.description: Neither Warner Bros. nor Disney have shown any sign that they plan to budge from the December 18 date, despite the obvious overlap in audience interest and theater demand.
